*Kagaya Ubuyashik has every demon slayer over 18 gather, to announce a new program, that includes, Tanjiro, Zenitsu, Insokue, Rengoku, Giyu, Mitsuri, Shinobu, Tengen, Muichiro, Genya, Obanai, Gyomei, Sanemi Hinatsuru, Makio, and Suma.*

Kagaya Ubuyashik: “with Muzan plotting his attacks against the hashira the hashira are in short supply of strong demon slayers. That’s is why I am employing a breeding program for all Demons slayers that are 18 plus, this goes for everyone

Tanjiro: “B-breeding?” *he was sitting near Zenitsu, Inosuke, and Giyu*

Zenitsu: “breeding!? Really???….oh my god….” *Zenitsu seems excited about this news, like he could blow off some steam*

Inosuke: “What’s breeding? Like Sex?…”

Rengoku: “If I may…..I have many questions….” *he was sitting near Tengen in the center of the room*

Giyu: “I too have many questions…” *he is sitting in the corner he was silent for most of the presentation*

Mitsuri: “this sounds….exciting..” *she was sitting with Shinobu*

Shinobu: “How do we decide who gets who? This seems like an excuse for fucking….” 

Geyomei: “Language Shinobu! And don’t put it so crudely, I believe this is a good idea” *he was sitting near the front of a he group*

Tengen: “Is that why my wives are here!?” *he seems pretty ticked off about the idea of other people haven’t his wives*

Sanamei: “Breeding!? Are we serious?…” *he is loud and annoyed, sitting near the center*

Muichiro: “what’s happening?” *he seems to not have been paying attention at all, he was sitting near window and gazing outside*

Makio: “Sex? Oh please these kids don’t have anything on me” *she says confidently, she is with the other wives who are next to Tengen*

Suma: “Makio! Please…stop it your embarrassing” *she is red in the face and blushing*

Hinatsuru: “Suma your overreacting!” *she lightly hits Suma’s arm*

*and then there’s you, your quiet and you keep to yourself,*
